goals.title: Contact Footer Visibility
goals.description: Add a footer with a contact email 'hello@openexec.io'
goals.success_criteria: Footer element exists with id='contact' containing the text 'Contact: hello@openexec.io'
goals.verification_method: Inspect index.html for footer element with correct content

goals.title: Dark Theme Footer Styling
goals.description: Ensure the footer matches the dark theme
goals.success_criteria: Footer has dark background color and light text color applied via inline styles
goals.verification_method: Inspect CSS styles in index.html style block for footer styling

stories.title: Codebase Study & Mapping
stories.description: As a developer, I need to study the existing index.html structure so that I understand where to add the footer and how existing styles are organized
acceptance_criteria: Existing style block patterns are identified
Insertion point for footer is determined

tasks.title: Study index.html structure
tasks.description: Read and analyze the existing index.html file to understand its structure, existing styles, and identify the correct insertion point for the footer element
tasks.technical_strategy: Read index.html completely to map the DOM structure, identify the closing body tag location, and document existing CSS patterns in the style block. Use safe_commit with story_id='US-001' and task_id='T-US-001-001' to persist any documentation.

stories.title: Add Contact Footer Element
stories.description: As a user, I want to see a contact section at the bottom of the page so that I can easily find the contact email
acceptance_criteria: Footer element with id='contact' exists in index.html
stories.verification_script: grep -q '<footer id="contact"' index.html && grep -q 'hello@openexec.io' index.html && echo 'Footer with contact email found'

tasks.title: Add footer element with contact email
tasks.description: Add a footer element with id='contact' containing the contact email text just before the closing body tag
tasks.technical_strategy: Insert <footer id='contact'>Contact: hello@openexec.io</footer> before the </body> tag in index.html. Ensure proper indentation matches existing code style. Use safe_commit with story_id='US-002' and task_id='T-US-002-001' to persist verified changes.
tasks.verification_script: grep -q '<footer id="contact"' index.html && grep -q 'Contact: hello@openexec.io' index.html

stories.title: Style Footer with Dark Theme
stories.description: As a user, I want the footer to have a dark background with light text so that it matches the overall dark theme of the page
acceptance_criteria: Footer has dark background color defined in style block
Footer has light text color defined in style block
Styles are added to existing style block without external CSS
stories.verification_script: grep -q '#contact' index.html && grep -q 'background' index.html && echo 'Footer styles found'

tasks.title: Add dark theme CSS styles for footer
tasks.description: Add CSS rules for the footer element with dark background and light text colors in the existing style block
tasks.technical_strategy: Add CSS rules for #contact selector with background-color set to a dark value (e.g., #1a1a1a or #222) and color set to a light value (e.g., #fff or #f0f0f0). Include padding for visual spacing. Use safe_commit with story_id='US-003' and task_id='T-US-003-001' to persist verified changes.

stories.title: Goal Validation
stories.description: As a project stakeholder, I want to validate that all goals have been met so that the implementation is complete and verified
acceptance_criteria: G-001: Footer with contact email exists
G-002: Footer has dark theme styling
No external CSS frameworks were used
stories.verification_script: grep -q '<footer id="contact"' index.html && grep -q 'hello@openexec.io' index.html && grep -q '#contact' index.html && ! grep -q 'bootstrap\|tailwind' index.html && echo 'All goals validated successfully'

tasks.title: Validate all project goals
tasks.description: Run comprehensive validation to ensure all goals and constraints are met
tasks.technical_strategy: Execute verification scripts for both goals: check footer element exists with correct id and content, verify dark background and light text CSS properties are present, confirm only index.html was modified and no external CSS frameworks are referenced. Use safe_commit with story_id='US-004' and task_id='T-US-004-001' to persist final validation.
tasks.verification_script: grep -q '<footer id="contact"' index.html && grep -q 'Contact: hello@openexec.io' index.html && grep -E 'background|color' index.html | grep -q '#contact' || grep -B2 -A5 '#contact' index.html | grep -qE 'background|color'
